senses: to observe, mark, give heed to, distinguish, consider
(Niphal) to be discerning, intelligent, discreet, have understanding
to cause to understand, give understanding, teach
(Hithpolel) to show oneself discerning or attentive, consider diligently

strongs.def: to separate mentally (or distinguish), i.e.(generally) understand
strongs.kjv: attend, consider, be cunning, diligently, direct, discern, eloquent, feel, inform, instruct, have intelligence, know, look well to, mark, perceive, be prudent, regard, (can) skill(-full), teach, think, (cause, make to, get, give, have) understand(-ing), view, (deal) wise(-ly, man)
